name_note: public_name stays null until approved; rendered videos never show the provisional name.
silhouette: Soft marshmallow: a dome-topped rounded block (width:height 1.27) whose lower 36% is a slightly darker base band with fully rounded bottom corners. No limbs at rest; one short rounded nub appears only for pointing/waving.

face.eyes: two vertical pill ovals, 7% x 20% of width, 18% apart, centred at 47% height
face.cheeks: two soft pink ovals on the band line, under and outside the eyes
face.mouth: hidden at rest; a small dark rounded slot appears only while speaking (driven by visemes/loudness)

gestures.point: nub extends toward the target; body leans 6 degrees
gestures.hop: small jump with squash and stretch

idle.blink: every 2.8-4.6 s (seeded) and on scene changes

placement_rules: Never overlap the content card or the headline band; the renderer clamps the character inside free space.
Companion size during dense demonstrations (code, diagrams, terminals).
Medium size beside a single object it is introducing.
Close-up only for the opening acknowledgement or one reaction per video.
Hidden when a visual needs full attention for its whole beat (e.g. a full-bleed clip).
speaking_cadence: Even, conversational; slight lift on the payoff word; never shouts.
behavior_rules: Reacts to content, never performs for its own sake.
At most one big reaction (surprised/celebrating) per video.
Looks at what the narration is talking about.
Dims slightly when the content needs focus.

signatures.entrance: pop-up: rises from below the hairline with a single blink and a tiny nod (first 0.5 s)
signatures.reveal: double-blink then happy arc eyes with a small hop when something impressive appears
signatures.cta: leans toward the keyword, points with the nub, and winks (one eye arcs) on the final word

exit: sink below the hairline with a fade
